## What changed

Describe the article, source, publication code, or operational change.

## Editorial and rights checks

- [ ] Attribution and canonical URLs are correct.
- [ ] I have the right to submit any included article text or media.
- [ ] Syndicated content matches the source registry permission and licence.
- [ ] Automation, synthetic narration, or generated media is disclosed where material.
- [ ] Factual claims link to inspectable evidence where practical.
- [ ] No publisher credential or generated release directory is committed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run sources:check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
